result.summary: Independent review of 25d0c17 (detached, clean, 22 changed paths matching the census; 18 commits over ff5c805..25d0c17 with red tests at 7715c51 preceding implementation at 850c8a8). The intentional B0 entry block is preserved and authenticated: policy-check emits ENTRY_BLOCKED_DECLARATION_UNBOUND as a diagnostic and entry-check now fails closed on it. OM-017 is the sole devai_reviewer_binding marker in the candidate tree, bound to claude-opus-5, digest 8ed49721986f7ada60505c0802ab6d71ef27cf4e179c8e0520fcd3ff88c88bd1 matching review-obligations.json; law/policy and .devai mirror bytes are identical (1f0a3666...). All five R3 classes are nevertheless declared GREEN_PROVED on populations that do not hold. Ten findings, eight P1. R3-F004 relies on three dead widenings: the previous_state_artifact branch is unreachable because law/schemas/review-state.schema.json:57 fixes additionalProperties:false without that key and no writer exists, the expectedClasses repair-population check is never supplied at its sole call site 9437, and the transport expected.state_before_digest compares a field to itself; the twelve edges and three terminals are asserted only as JSON counts. R3-F005 still lets dirty worktree bytes pick the dispatch version and the strict-candidate rule whenever --candidate is omitted, and loadPolicy/validateDocument remain worktree-bound for smart-converge, review-scope, review-check and nine other commands. R3-F002 drops untracked generated executables (packages/cli/dist/bin.js), never recurses into referenced or extended tsconfigs, derives no tsconfig outputs, and extracts programs from a six-name allowlist. R3-F003 misses aliased, non-module destructured and globalThis-computed loader forms inside the owned selector packages/cli/src/**/*.ts. R3-F001 replaced the policy-check gate with a two-file byte comparison, executes 1 of 16 literal argv rows, and proves failure-ordinal retention through a no-op wrapper. status reports entry_ready true while entry-check fails, locked in by a test edit. Nine hardcoded 'DII-251' literals scope every repair to one profile, evading the existing guard that only forbids 'DII-246' and 'DII-248'. Red evidence is internally inconsistent and was re-anchored after implementation.
